candidates.topic: Four Planets Retrograde Right Now — September 2026
candidates.teaser: Four planets are retrograde at the same time right now — and astrologers say one of them is the most disruptive.
candidates.video_title: 4 Planets Are Retrograde Right Now — One Changes Everything
candidates.video_description: Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, and Pluto are all retrograde simultaneously in September 2026. Astrologers interpret this as a rare period of deep internal revision across structures, identity, and power. Here's what that means for you.
candidates.script: Four planets are retrograde right now — at the exact same time. Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, and Pluto are all moving backward, and in astrology, that's not random noise. Saturn in Aries is pressuring your foundations. Uranus in Gemini is rewiring how you think. Neptune in Aries is dissolving what you thought was real. And Pluto in Aquarius is quietly dismantling power structures from the inside out. The question isn't whether you feel this — it's which layer of your life is cracking open first.

candidates.topic: Waxing Crescent Moon in Libra — Building Toward Balance
candidates.teaser: The Moon is in Libra right now, and it's asking you one very uncomfortable question about your relationships.
candidates.video_title: Waxing Crescent in Libra — What Are You Actually Building?
candidates.video_description: The Waxing Crescent Moon in Libra on September 13, 2026 sits at 21.5° — a phase of intention and momentum in the sign of balance and partnership. In astrology, this is a window to consciously choose what you're growing toward.
candidates.script: The Moon is in Libra right now, and it's in its Waxing Crescent phase — the moment in the lunar cycle when what you planted at the New Moon starts to push through. Libra rules relationships, fairness, and the choices you keep postponing. In astrology, a Waxing Crescent in Libra is a direct signal: you're building something, whether you're conscious of it or not. The real question this Moon is asking — what are you choosing to grow toward, and what are you only pretending to be neutral about?

candidates.topic: Venus in Scorpio — Desire, Obsession, and the Dark Side of Wanting
candidates.teaser: Venus just moved into Scorpio, and astrologers say it's the most intense placement Venus can be in — here's why.
candidates.video_title: Venus in Scorpio — When Desire Becomes Obsession
candidates.video_description: With Venus now at 2.1° Scorpio, astrology interprets this as a shift from surface-level attraction to deep, consuming desire. This placement is historically linked to themes of jealousy, hidden feelings, and transformative love.
candidates.script: Venus in Scorpio doesn't flirt — it obsesses. Right now Venus sits at 2 degrees Scorpio, and in astrology this is one of the most intense placements the planet of love can occupy. Scorpio is ruled by Pluto, the planet of death and transformation, so when Venus moves through here, traditional astrologers say desire stops being light and starts being all-consuming. This is the placement of wanting something so deeply it scares you. What — or who — are you not letting yourself fully want right now?

candidates.topic: The Astrological 7th House — The House of Other People
candidates.teaser: There's one house in your birth chart that reveals exactly what you unconsciously look for in every relationship — most people never look at it.
candidates.video_title: Your 7th House: The Chart Placement About Other People
candidates.video_description: The 7th house in astrology rules committed partnerships, open enemies, and the qualities you tend to project onto others. The sign on your 7th house cusp — your Descendant — is considered the mirror of your rising sign and a key to relationship patterns.
candidates.script: The sign on your 7th house cusp is literally called the Descendant — and it's the direct mirror of your rising sign. In astrology, the 7th house governs committed partnerships, contracts, and what traditional texts call open enemies. But here's what most people miss: astrologers interpret this house as the qualities you don't recognize in yourself and keep attracting in others. Your rising sign is who you project outward. Your 7th house is what keeps walking back through the door. Do you know what sign rules yours?

candidates.topic: Mercury in Libra — Communication Shifts from Logic to Diplomacy
candidates.teaser: Mercury just left Virgo and moved into Libra — and the way you think and talk is about to feel completely different.
candidates.video_title: Mercury in Libra — Your Mind Just Changed How It Works
candidates.video_description: With Mercury now at 4.9° Libra, astrology marks a shift from Virgo's analytical precision to Libra's weighing of all sides. This transit is interpreted as a period where communication becomes more diplomatic — but also more indecisive.
candidates.script: Mercury just moved into Libra, and in astrology that shift matters more than most people realize. In Virgo, Mercury analyzes, categorizes, and cuts through noise — it's sharp and precise. But in Libra, the same planet starts weighing every option against every other option. Astrologers describe Mercury in Libra as the diplomat of the zodiac: brilliant at seeing all sides, but slower to commit to one. Right now at nearly 5 degrees Libra, conversations get more balanced — and more carefully chosen. Are you being diplomatic, or are you just avoiding the hard thing?
